title: Test that a Claude evaluator child's real spawn path passes --strict-mcp-config, not only the argument builder
outcome: Low from the round-2 Claude review (delegation-af9f32d5-f27e-4f72-ae00-c155e3df3029) of the evaluator tool-access change, left unfixed at landing under the Low rule. The test a_claude_evaluator_child_starts_on_the_host_mcp_configuration_alone (src/tests/evaluator_tool_access.rs) rebuilds the launch arguments in a closure from claude_cli_mcp_config_args and session_is_acceptance_evaluator_child_locked. It does not show that the real spawn sites pass the flag: the three start_turn_on_record callers in turn_dispatch.rs and the model-options spawn in session_config.rs. An edit that passes false at one site would pass every test while a Claude evaluator again loads servers from the user's, project's and local Claude settings. Assert the flag at a real dispatch site, for example through a spawn-argument capture hook or by checking the value start_turn_on_record receives when an evaluator child's queued turn is dispatched.
acceptance: A test dispatches a queued turn for a Claude acceptance-evaluator child through the real dispatch path and observes --strict-mcp-config in the launch arguments or the flag reaching spawn_claude_runtime, and observes its absence for a reviewer child; the test fails if any spawn site passes false for the evaluator.
